blocks.text: Cloverdale Detached Homes Under $1.8M — Frequently Asked Questions

parts.t: What types of detached houses sell under $1.8M in Cloverdale?
In
Cloverdale

, the sub-$1.8M detached market splits into two primary housing forms: 1970s–1990s rancher, split-level, and two-storey single-family homes on 6,000 to 7,500 sq ft lots in central Cloverdale, and 2005–2018 compact-lot houses in Clayton Heights on 3,000 to 4,200 sq ft lots with rear lane access.
What is a Clayton coach home and how does it work?

Many Clayton Heights single-family lots under $1.8M are zoned RF-12c or RF-13, allowing a main house plus a legal 1-bedroom carriage suite (coach house) built above the detached rear garage, often alongside a separate basement suite in the main dwelling.
How do I verify if a basement suite or coach house is legal in Surrey?

Check City of Surrey building-permit records and secondary-suite utility billing status. A legal secondary suite or coach house will have final occupancy permits on file with the City of Surrey and appear on the annual utility notice for secondary suite services.
How will provincial SSMUH small-scale multi-unit rules affect Cloverdale lots under $1.8M?

British Columbia Bill 44 (Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing) requires municipalities to allow 3 to 6 units on qualifying single-family lots inside the Urban Containment Boundary, depending on lot size and proximity to frequent transit, subject to City of Surrey servicing capacity and tree-protection bylaws.
Which high schools serve Cloverdale detached neighbourhoods?

Detached neighbourhoods south of 64 Avenue and around Cloverdale Town Centre generally feed into Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary, while Clayton sectors north of 64 Avenue feed into Clayton Heights Secondary or Salish Secondary. Confirm exact street boundaries with Surrey School District 36.
What lot sizes are most common for Cloverdale homes under $1.8M?

Older central Cloverdale subdivisions near 176 Street, 180 Street, and 58 Avenue typically offer 60-by-100-foot to 66-by-110-foot rectangular lots (6,000–7,260 sq ft), whereas Clayton lane lots typically measure 30 to 42 feet wide by 100 to 110 feet deep.
How do Cloverdale homes under $1.8M compare with homes over $1.8M?
